title.raw: Fall Severe Weather Preparedness Week Highlights Safety Tips
title.rendered: Fall Severe Weather Preparedness Week Highlights Safety Tips

excerpt.raw: Authorities urge residents to review safety plans and prepare for potential fall storms during Severe Weather Preparedness Week.
excerpt.rendered: Authorities urge residents to review safety plans and prepare for potential fall storms during Severe Weather Preparedness Week.

content.raw:
Severe weather can occur at any time of year, including fall, prompting officials to emphasize preparedness during Fall Severe Weather Preparedness Week. Authorities recommend residents review safety plans, identify safe locations, and ensure they know how to receive weather alerts before storms develop.

The Missouri Emergency Management Agency (MEMA) released a video outlining key steps families can take to stay safe. These include identifying a safe place to shelter, understanding how to receive emergency notifications, and creating a household emergency plan.

Officials advise residents to take proactive measures now to protect themselves and their families from potential severe weather events. Being prepared ahead of time can make a critical difference in response and safety during storms.

Source: Original Article

payload.title: Ingomar sweeps Tupelo Christian Prep in Oct. 12 North Half final
payload.excerpt: Ingomar beat Tupelo Christian Prep 3–0 at home Monday, Oct. 12, to earn a berth in the Class 1A state volleyball final.
payload.content:
Ingomar defeated Tupelo Christian Prep 3–0 at home Monday, Oct. 12, to win the North Half volleyball final and advance to the Class 1A state championship.

The Lady Falcons won 29–27, 25–10, 25–19, according to the MaxPreps match report.

The Lady Falcons will face Resurrection in the state final. Read our championship preview for the opponent, time and venue.

Correction: An earlier version of this article incorrectly said the North Half match was scheduled for Tuesday. It was played Monday, Oct. 12, 2026. The article has also been updated with the result.

payload.title: Ingomar to face Resurrection in Class 1A volleyball final Friday
payload.excerpt: The Lady Falcons will play Resurrection at noon Friday, Oct. 16, at A.E. Wood Coliseum in Clinton for the Class 1A state championship.
payload.content:
Ingomar will face Resurrection in the Class 1A state volleyball final at noon Friday, Oct. 16, at Mississippi College's A.E. Wood Coliseum in Clinton, according to the MHSAA championship schedule.

The Lady Falcons advanced by sweeping Tupelo Christian Prep 3–0 on Monday, Oct. 12. MaxPreps lists Ingomar at 25–7 after that victory.

Ingomar has won all four of its playoff matches in straight sets, beating Biggersville, Potts Camp, Pine Grove and Tupelo Christian Prep, according to its MaxPreps schedule.

The MHSAA championship page provides ticket and livestream links for fans.

Correction: An earlier version said the state tournament would begin next week. The championships are Oct. 15–16, 2026, with Ingomar's final scheduled for Oct. 16. The opponent, time and venue have been added.

payload.title: New Albany sweeps Mooreville to reach Class 4A volleyball final
payload.excerpt: New Albany beat Mooreville 25–22, 25–13, 25–19 on Monday, completing a fourth straight playoff sweep and returning to the Class 4A final.
payload.content:
New Albany swept Mooreville 3–0 on the road Monday, Oct. 12, to advance to the Class 4A state volleyball championship.

The Bulldogs won 25–22, 25–13, 25–19, according to the MHSAA-linked tournament bracket on MaxPreps. Their team schedule lists the match at Mooreville and a 32–9 overall record after the win.

New Albany has not dropped a set in this postseason. The Bulldogs also swept Byhalia in the first round, Amory in the second round and Ripley in the third round.

The Bulldogs are the defending Class 4A champions. MHSAA records show New Albany beat Newton County 3–2 in the 2025 final.

New Albany will face Choctaw Central for this year's title. See our championship preview for Friday's time and venue.

Correction: An earlier version incorrectly suggested New Albany was seeking its first state title under the current classification. New Albany won the Class 4A championship in 2025.

payload.title: New Albany's Class 4A title defense: Friday's opponent, time and venue
payload.excerpt: Defending champion New Albany meets Choctaw Central at 2 p.m. Friday, Oct. 16, at A.E. Wood Coliseum in Clinton.
payload.content:
New Albany will defend its Class 4A volleyball title against Choctaw Central at 2 p.m. Friday, Oct. 16, at Mississippi College's A.E. Wood Coliseum in Clinton. The matchup is listed on the MHSAA championship schedule.

The Bulldogs won last year's championship by defeating Newton County in five sets, according to MHSAA's 2025 final result.

Choctaw Central reached this year's final with a 3–1 semifinal win over Newton County on Oct. 12, according to the MHSAA-linked MaxPreps bracket.

Fans can find the Class 4A ticket link and livestream information on the MHSAA championship page.

Read our semifinal recap for New Albany's victory over Mooreville and its playoff results.
